decisions.statement: Each tracker the add-on ships is a workspace package of its own.
This add-on starts each tracker and knows nothing else about that tracker.
A tracker publishes its own global rather than a member of this add-on's.
The three XML documents load after the Lua bundle.
The saved variables of all five trackers are named in the one manifest.
Nothing here reads the data a tracker keeps.

definition: the add-on shipping the skyshard, lorebook, treasure, champion and item-set trackers as one
